g.text: Gene-level effect sizes for the field-effect contrast
Bars are bootstrap 95% CIs. Filled markers pass BH-FDR within this contrast. Both pre-specified hypotheses were tested on the composite
index; the gene-level panel is descriptive. The array cohort is analyzed as an independent arm and never merged with the RNA-seq cohorts.
